content: Postgres practitioner consensus (Crunchy Data, Close, boringSQL, Scaling Postgres) favors CHECK constraints with a text column over native ENUM types for small closed vocabularies: ENUM values can be added but adding a value acquires a stronger lock profile and cannot be removed without dropping/recreating the type, while a CHECK constraint can be dropped and re-added in a single lightweight DDL statement (ADD/DROP CONSTRAINT) without a type-catalog change. Many practitioners report defaulting to CHECK constraints specifically for this flexibility.
